description: Unit test class for LeavePeriodService within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, testing date range retrieval, leave period handling, and related functionalities.

classes.name: LeavePeriodServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for the LeavePeriodService class, testing various date and leave period related methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LeavePeriodService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetListOfMonths
methods.description: Verifies that getListOfMonths returns all months in the correct order.

methods.name: testGetListOfDates
methods.description: Checks that getListOfDates returns correct date ranges for all months, including leap year considerations and invalid inputs.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Ensures the getter for LeavePeriodDao returns an instance of the expected class.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Validates that the service correctly retrieves the current leave period's start month and day, with and without cache refresh.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodWhenNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when leave period is not configured, expecting null.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Checks that the current leave period is fetched correctly when it is defined, considering today's date.

methods.name: testGetNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Verifies normalization of the current leave period data into a structured array.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDateWhenLeavePeriodNotDefined
methods.description: Ensures null is returned when leave period configuration is absent.

methods.name: testGetMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Data-driven test to verify calculation of the maximum allowed leave period end date based on current date and start date parameters.
